item.statement: The operator is deterministic and race-free: each output element has a single writer and reads only immutable source data.

plans.objective: Verify write-once, read-only-source structure and determinism.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact for inspection, and run two identical launches on Ascend 950PR capturing both odata buffers.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff static inspection shows one writer per logical output element and no source mutation, and both runs are bitwise identical to each other and to the host oracle.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate kernel for shared mutable state, multiple writers to one output element, or source mutation; then run two identical launches and compare.
